title: MLB reference-source ownership and integration boundary

ontologistDecision.rationale: The ontologist accepted the division in which MLB-game owns game and event facts plus canonical identity links, while MLB-organizations, MLB-people, MLB-venues, and MLB-transactions independently own their reference facts and meet only in the authoritative triple store. Existing promoted game RDF persists. The source-module catalog may record this ownership, but executable mappings and the coordinated query cutover require later approved source-specific Mermaid contracts.
